decision: These entries document compatibility-constrained resolved-classpath residuals so the advisory gate can detect unreviewed drift. They do not claim remediation and do not replace launch-owner or security sign-off.

residuals.name: com.lightbend.akka.management:akka-management_2.13
residuals.rationale: Direct Akka Management residual. Narrow upgrade candidates did not remove the resolved finding cleanly in this repository setup; fixing it safely belongs with an Akka-family migration and route/runtime compatibility review instead of a lone override.

residuals.name: com.typesafe.akka:akka-http-core_2.13
residuals.rationale: Direct Akka HTTP residual. The fixed 10.5.x line resolved as available but introduced a Scala XML eviction conflict with inherited Scalate/Spoiwo dependencies, so a safe fix requires coordinated Akka HTTP/XML and dependent-library migration evidence.

residuals.name: com.typesafe.akka:akka-stream-kafka_2.13
residuals.rationale: Direct Akka Streams Kafka residual. Version 4.0.2 removed this advisory but pulled Akka 2.7 artifacts into the inherited Akka 2.6.19 runtime and failed ActorSystem startup; remediation needs a coordinated Akka runtime migration rather than an isolated adapter bump.

residuals.name: org.bouncycastle:bcpkix-jdk15on
residuals.rationale: Keycloak transitive BouncyCastle residual. Same-artifact jdk15on candidates remain OSV-positive and switching to jdk18on families is tied to the Keycloak/auth runtime migration, so this is tracked as compatibility-constrained until the auth stack is migrated.

residuals.name: org.bouncycastle:bcprov-jdk15on
residuals.rationale: SendGrid/Keycloak transitive BouncyCastle residual. Same-artifact jdk15on versions remain OSV-positive and replacement artifact families require auth/runtime dependency migration review, so this entry records the current compatibility boundary and drift check.

residuals.name: org.keycloak:keycloak-adapter-core
residuals.rationale: Direct Keycloak adapter residual. No matching current 26.x adapter artifact was found for the inherited adapter line; the 25.0.3 trial failed backend compilation against the inherited adapter APIs and increased resolved residual coordinates.

residuals.name: org.keycloak:keycloak-core
residuals.rationale: Direct Keycloak core/admin/authz residual. Newer major Keycloak candidates require auth/session API migration; the 25.0.3 trial failed inherited adapter/client compilation and worsened the resolved residual count, so this remains a planned auth migration rather than a safe point override.

residuals.name: org.yaml:snakeyaml
residuals.rationale: Tapir/circe-yaml transitive SnakeYAML residual. SnakeYAML 2.x candidates failed strict Coursier resolution on missing android artifacts, and the 1.33 trial still carried a finding while converting SnakeYAML into a direct residual; the retained OpenAPI YAML regression guards future migration attempts.
